svg.title: ShopNow private GCP access: no VPN, no access
svg.desc: Nothing in the application is public: clients reach it only over the VPN, through private DNS, an internal load balancer and Apigee
svg.text: ShopNow private GCP access: no VPN, no access
Nothing in the application is public: clients reach it only over the VPN, through private DNS, an internal load balancer and Apigee
GOOGLE CLOUD · Terraform-managed · no public application ingress
Private GKE cluster · internal Gateway / Ingress
Three controls must all hold: a route (VPN + BGP), a name (private DNS forwarded across the VPN) and a policy (firewall + Apigee).
